issues.description: The explicit fallback contract is still internally inconsistent. The public soft-failure docs say path clips fall back to a bounding rect and radial/conic gradients fall back to the gradient start color (`GPUISceneBridge.swift:42-43`, `182`), but the implementation uses a full-surface no-op for `.path` clips (`GPUISceneBridge.swift:109-111`) and preserves the command's base color for radial/conic gradients (`GPUISceneBridge.swift:209-211`). The focused tests codify those implemented behaviors instead (`GPUISceneBridgeTests.swift:443-445`, `473-475`, `519-524`). Because this feature is specifically about explicit unsupported-style fallback choices, the prior documentation mismatch remains unresolved.
